thread:
Ava Ramos: FYI — noticed a usage gap for ACME Corp on the embedding counts for the Mar 18 billing window. Our expected embed units ~2.8M, invoice shows 2.5M (~11% lower). Looks like ingestion gap between 2026-03-18T02:05Z and 2026-03-18T04:20Z. Can eng confirm if events were lost or if this is a reporting reconciliation issue? Link to query: https://internal.redwood/queries/ingest-gap-1795 :eyes:

Eli Chen: thx. I pulled the raw event counts from the kafka partition and we do see a drop in consumer throughput in that window. Consumer group `metering-processor-v2` lag spiked ~45m.

Eli Chen: snippet from the consumer lag timeline:
```
2026-03-18T01:55Z lag=12
2026-03-18T02:10Z lag=1200   <-- spike
2026-03-18T03:30Z lag=0
```
Looks like a transient outage on the metering worker that didn't auto-retry.

Priya Kapoor: SRE saw an autoscaler bounce around that period — a node terminated during GC and leader election slowed processing. Pagerlog shows an autoscale event at 02:08 UTC. I filed INC-2026-131, linking logs: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-131.

Marco Diaz: ACME already pinged CSM asking why their invoice is lower than expected (they thought it was higher 🤦). They want an explanation + whether we can backfill so their internal reconciliation matches our ledger. They are worried we undercounted (they're used to higher numbers).

Zoe Martinez: For finance ops: do we do a backfill into the metering ledger or issue a corrective invoice? What's the standard for ingestion gaps that reduce billable usage?

Ava Ramos: Historically we've done backfills when the ledger undercounts (customer-facing impact) and then adjusted the next invoice or issued a one-off credit if the correction is small and time-sensitive. Need an estimate of delta in dollar terms and time to backfill.

Eli Chen: Proposed plan:
1) Reingest raw events from kafka offsets for that timeframe (we still have raw logs)
2) Recompute embedding unit aggregates per-customer
3) Apply ledger adjustments + emit audit rows and invoice change log
4) Notify ops + CSM and adjust next invoice or create an amendment invoice depending on legal threshold (> $5000 we do amendment)

Estimate: Reingest + recompute for that single tenant ~2–3 hours of engineer + ~1 hour for ledger validation. If we do automated pipeline it might be ~30–45 minutes. Dollar delta estimate for ACME: ~$420 (rough) — they were undercounted ~300k embed units at $0.0014/unit.

Zoe Martinez: $420 is < $5k so per policy we can do ledger backfill and adjust next invoice (no amendment). Need approval from Finance lead (Ava) and Ops to run pipeline. Also need a short message for CSM to share with ACME.

Priya Kapoor: I'll queue the reingest on the metering cluster after Eli gives the exact offsets & runbook. We'll run in read-only mode then validate diffs. ETA for a run: 1.5–2 hours once started, low-risk.

Eli Chen: Offsets I plan to reingest: topic `meter-events`, partitions 3–7, offsets 1245120–1249000. Command (internal):
```
./tools/reingest --topic meter-events --start 1245120 --end 1249000 --filter tenant=acme-corp --dry-run
```
I'll do a dry-run first and post the delta.

Ava Ramos: Approving the backfill/dry-run. Please include a one-paragraph blurb CSM can send to ACME: we discovered transient processing lag; we reprocessed events and will reconcile ledger on next invoice; no action needed on your side.

Marco Diaz: Assigned to @CSM-Leah to communicate once we have validated numbers. CSM will ask ACME if they'd prefer a one-off invoice amendment vs next-month adjustment (but likely choose next-month).

billing-bot: NOTE: Any ledger adjustments will trigger an audit event. Please ensure `ledger-adjustment:reason` is populated. See KB: https://docs.redwood/internal/billing/ledger-adjustments

Eli Chen: Dry-run results: delta = +309,842 embed units for ACME, projected charge = +$433.78. I validated hashes on reingested batch. No conflicts.

Zoe Martinez: OK to proceed with actual reingest and ledger write. Ava, this is still within discretionary correction limit.

Ava Ramos: Proceed. Zoe — please prepare an email template. Marco/CSM — please hold message until we write the ledger. Also tag Legal if ACME requests an amendment.

Priya Kapoor: Starting the write job now in maintenance window flag. ETA 45m. I will watch for any downstream spikes.

Eli Chen: Write complete. Audit IDs: ADJ-2026-8341. Ledger shows +309,842 embed units added for tenant acme-corp. Posting to invoice adjustments queue.

Zoe Martinez: Logged adjustment, will update invoice records and close the reconciliation ticket. Note for bookkeeping: revenue recognition unaffected until cash collection, but ledger reflects corrected usage.

Marco Diaz: Sent message to CSM-Leah to inform ACME. Draft copy:
"We reprocessed a short window of telemetry and found missing usage; we've adjusted your usage ledger by +309,842 embed units. This will be reflected on your next invoice. If you'd prefer a one-off amendment, let us know and we'll escalate."

Ava Ramos: Thanks everyone. Closing the thread after CSM confirms customer message sent. :white_check_mark:

Marco Diaz: CSM confirmed — message sent and ACME replied :thumbsup: — they appreciate the transparency.
